evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.922 Torr at the start of growth with Ar set to 100 sccm.
Pressure rose to 3.053 Torr under unchanged growth setpoints.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.191 Torr, about 9% above the start of growth despite stable temperature and argon flow.
Temperature is 750.0 °C at a 750.0 °C setpoint, Ar is 99.6 sccm at a 100 sccm setpoint, and controller reports running.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; pressure and flow cannot establish atmosphere purity.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile and tolerances; independent pressure confirmation and leak/exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish causes of the pressure rise; oxygen measurement to verify atmosphere purity; sample characterization to assess growth.
